description_text:
+++++++++++++++
BEFORE YOU MAKE PURCHASE:

  - My models are built on sizes and images from the internet. Therefore it will not be absolutely accurate compared to the real model.

  - If you cannot find the format that you need, contact me before purchasing or reviewing the product. I will assist you, including the refunds.

  - For formats where the model is not subdivision yet, don't worry, contact me and I'll help you with that. ( I will export and send to you high poly/ smooth version ).

  - Because of the different time zones, my response time is usually 12 hours. Please be patient. I will respond as quickly as possible.

+++++++++++++++
Features:

  - High quality polygonal model. Mesh and details are built by our professional artists.

  - Models resolutions are optimized for polygon efficiency. (In 3ds Max, the Meshsmooth function can be used to increase mesh resolution if necessary.)

  - 3ds Max models are grouped for easy selection, and objects are logically named for ease of scene management.

  - No part-name confusion when importing several models into a scene.

  - No cleaning up necessaryjust drop your models into the scene and start rendering.

  - No special plugin needed to open scene.

+++++++++++++++
File Formats:

  - 3ds Max 2018 + V-Ray ( 3.6 ) and standard materials scenes

  - OBJ 2018 (Multi Format)

  - 3DS 2018 (Multi Format)

  - FBX 2018 (Multi Format)

  - Maya 2018 with standard materials

  - Cinema 4D R20 with standard materials

  - Blender 2.91

( If you need other formats or lower version please contact me, I will export and setup for you. )
+++++++++++++++
Textures: ( just for the models have textures, some models have not textures because it just contain base material )
  - Models was textured will be seen in the preview image and the infobox next to it. Models have no texture just contain standard materials.
For models have texture:

  - High resolution ( up to 4096x4096 pixels for big parts and 2048x2048 pixels for small parts ).

  - If you need 8K or higher texture, please contact me.

  - About UVs: Some models have no UV if it has no texture (it only materials have no texture ). If you need UV for the models please contact me and I will help you.

+++++++++++++++

  - NOTE for Cinima 4D users: add HyperNURBS for each object to get subdivision ( smooth ). And make sure setting of HyperNURBS is Catmull-Clark and Subdivide UVs is Edge to correct textures and UVs.

  - NOTE: If you have problem with extract file please use latest version of winrar ( winrar is free )

If you can't extract file, please contact me and I will help you.
  - Also check out our other models, just click on my user name to see complete gallery.

description_text:
(Zip files are larger due to the amount of textures).
Low-poly 3D hat models, UV unwrapped, with textures and materials, not rigged.
Polygons: 310 (hat only) - 518 (hat with water drops)Vertices: 235 (hat only) - 445 (hat with water drops)
Images included have resolution of 1024x1024 pixels.
10 color sets: white, black, red, orange, yellow, green, cyan, blue, purple and pink.
Includes an optional layer of water drops for the hats.
There are 2 hat versions with different UV layouts: Hat-UV-1 has 4 separate UV islands for the outer cone, inner cone, brim topside and brim underside. Hat-UV-2 has the same UV island for both the outer cone and inner cone, thus the inner cone displays the same texture as the outer cone.You can use whichever is useful for your purposes (the UV version 2 was better for usage in Second Life).
Includes also .obj, .mtl and .dae files.You will need to adjust the materials and textures settings after importing the .obj files.
In Blender, the models are set to 4 different layers. Enable each layer to make each set of models visible.
The Witches' Summer Hats work perfectly for Second Life.
What you receive in this product:
-1 Blender (.blend) file (with materials and all 22 textures linked).-5 Wavefront (.obj) files and their 5 .mtl files (with materials and textures linked).-5 Collada (.dae) files (with materials and diffuse textures linked).-20 diffuse images (10 .jpg files for the hats and 10 .tga files for the water drops).-1 baked diffuse image for the hats (.png).-1 normal image for the water drops (.tga).-1 specular image for the water drops (.tga).-3 UV layouts (.png).
The .obj/.mtl/.dae files are these:
Witches-Summer-Hat-UV-1Witches-Summer-Hat-UV-2Water-Drops-LayerWitches-Summer-Hat-UV-1-and-Water-DropsWitches-Summer-Hat-UV-2-and-Water-Drops

This is a typical viking round shield. It is built from wooden planks, has a round, hollow boss made from steel, a rim made out of raw hide, which is sewn through the planks to reinforce the shield. glued to the front side is a layer of linen cloth, which also reinforces the shield and prevents the planks from splintering.The boss and the wooden handle are held in place by iron rivets, the handle is wrapet by leather. Download this classic spooky bed sheet ghost for you Halloween scene. Edit the material to change how transparent the ghost appears in your scene. In the examples images I provided I placed the ghost in a haunted house scene. *****Haunted house and pumpkin not included in this download. 
There is perhaps no Halloween costume more clichéd than the easy-peasy “bedsheet ghost,” the most primitive of which can be fashioned with nothing but white linens and scissors for eyeholes.We’ve seen it worn by characters like Charlie Brown, Michael Myers and Spongebob Squarepants (who was chagrined to be mistaken for a “haunted mattress,” prompting him to shave down his rectangular body’s corners.)But if pop culture has solidified our image of this DIY spectre as a go-to Trick-or-Treating getup, then it begs the question: how the heck did we decide that ghosts look like walking sheets? Given the major influx of Irish arrivals in wake of the mid-19th Century potato famine, it is no surprise that Halloween borrows heavily from Celtic paganism: including nods to spirits of ancestral dead, costumes, and a neighborly ritual that would eventually become Trick-or-Treating. Early Halloween costumes tended to be simple, spooky, and cheap--which naturally led to bedsheet ghosts.

description_text:
Checkout the different designs in my collection from simple cute designs to scary organic sculpts. 
Take note to double check and resize accordingly before 3D printing.I have included many files of different level of details for your convenience. Refer to filename for Poly Count (K=thousands of Triangle polygons).
These are Oculus Home ready models, just copy the .GLB files, which are just binary versions of the new glTR file format into your “oculus home ->  _import” folder. 
Most of my work is sculpted directly in Oculus Medium VR.Most objects are separate elements which means you can mix and match to achieve the effect you want.
The photos and videos are created directly in the Medium VR 3D engine.I definitely had fun creating this project from within VR. 
The hair alone took up nearly 90% of the time spent, hahaha ;pIf you enjoy what you see then give a like or comment to support more of this effort.

description_text:
Game-ready starfish models and a geometry nodes setup for random distribution in any environment.
All varieties are grouped into a single blender file, including a geometry nodes setup for distributing the starfish over an object. Each variety is also included as a separate fbx file in highpoly and lowpoly versions, which are optimized for Unity and Unreal.
The detailed, high-res models are ideal for close-up rendering. The lowpoly versions are optimized for use as background props in larger scenes. The included Blender file contains a geometry nodes setup that distributes the starfish over any object, so you can quickly add them as ground clutter to your scenes.
Poly Counts:
High-poly versions contain between 1,510 and 26,501 vertices per model. Low poly versions have between 100 and 2,800 vertices per model. All models are UV unwrapped with non-overlapping islands.
Note: highpoly versions have clean topology and use quads (and n-gons to fill the center on their undersides). Lowpoly versions do not have clean topology, and use tris instead of quads.
Materials:
Each starfish has its own color map (2048 x 2048) and uses a procedural normal map. Color maps, materials, and preview renders are all labeled with the id number of the corresponding starfish.

description_text:
Four miniatures for Mice & Mystics (base game + Heart of Glorm expansion + Downwood Tales expansion), or any 25-30mm scale miniature game.

  -     Cheese Golem

  -     Ladybug familiar

  -     Slug pet (Heart of Glorm)

  -     Doodlebug familiar (Downwood Tales)

Each mini is on a 20mm diameter base (21mm for the ladybug & doodlebug).
Ladybug is in two variants : 1-part (mini is attached to the base), and 2-parts (mini and base have a hole, mini has to be pinned to the base with a piece of paperclip or metal rod).
Print several copies to replace cardboard tokens in your game (typically : 4x slugs, 1x the rest).
Recommended printer : SLA or DLP (resin).
Print-tested on DLP with supports.
Important:
These models require supports that can be tricky to remove. Experience in support removal on delicate prints is recommended !
2 files, one with all parts assembled in a single stl file, the other with parts in separated stl files (zipped).

description_text:
Coming from the shadows we have the Xenoteras Lurker! This sneaky creatures can camouflage with the surrounding environment and use their extra strong ripping claws to easily end with their targets. If that´s not enough, they also have strong talons, with a serrated shape to cause extra damage. Their tendrils can shoot some poisonous spikes that incapacitate the target before the job is done. You simply don´t want to get near...that if you see them.
The reference base in the pictures is 40mm, making it both taller and bigger overall than the rest of the similar rank troops (they need to be scary). There are two body versions, one with tendrils on the back and one without, leaving to your choice which one to use (and probably easier to print).

KAWS is an American graffiti artist and designer known for his toys, paintings, and prints. Pop Art and culture permeate his cartoonish Companion series of figurines, which bear a resemblance to the works of Takashi Murakami. KAWS is a multi-faceted artist straddling the worlds of art and design in his prolific body of work that ranges from paintings, murals, and large-scale sculptures to product design and toy-making. His iconic “XX” signature has its roots in the beginning of his career as a street artist in the 1990s, when he began altering found advertisements by incorporating his own masterful paintings. Evoking the sensibilities of Pop artists like Andy Warhol and Claes Oldenburg, KAWS possesses a sophisticated humor and thoughtful interplay with consumer products and collaborations with global brands. He often draws inspiration and appropriates from popular culture animations to form a unique artistic vocabulary and influential cast of hybrid cartoon and human characters.

description_text:
An unusual jewelry box is a good idea for a gift and decoration at home, and this is about one of those things that show that buying a 3D printer is a good idea.This jewelry box of classical shape decorated with the relief and figure of a sitting ballerina was designed specifically for trouble-free printing with a minimum number of supports (a small number of supports is needed only for printing figures) and with maximum productivity. The laconic form and smooth surface are rather simply ground during post-processing. Such a surface looks great with various painting methods and provides a beautiful game of glare and shadows.
Project page: https://3dladnik.wixsite.com/workshop/jewelrybox2?lang=en
Dimensions of the box: 190 x 190 x 75 mm.Jewelry box height with a figurine: 220 mm.
Plastic Consumption: 390 grams of ABS plastic.
Post-processing: grinding, chemical polishing with ethyl acetate.Coloring: acrylic enamels and polyurethane varnish. It was painted with a brush.
The lid of the box is glued in two parts: JewelryBox2-1.STL and JewelryBox2-2.STL.The figurine is attached to the lid with a screw.
The jewelry box shown was printed on a Lad-1.0 FDM printer with a nozzle of 0.5 mm, a layer height of 0.2 mm when printing the case and 0.15 mm when printing the figurine.

description_text:
Based on the legendary character, depicted in the 1969 Rankin Bass holiday film Jack Frost,  the model is just over 143mm tall on the base.  Off base, the stand is about 138mm tall.  Jack was designed as a freestanding character, but printing with the base creates additional stability.  Jack is a detailed model, including details from the animated feature and a few other details.  The pose is based on the scene where Jack makes a request to become human.  The model is scalable. Printed on an LCD resin printer, they should survive well at small scales. 
Updated in December of 2025, this purchase includes version 1 and 2 of the character. They both hold similar poses and scale, but the design of version 2 and several sculptural details have been revised.  It also includes a new base for version 2.  Jack v2 has also been provided assembled and in parts to allow for more print options and printbed orientations.

--------------------( (About the Model )) -------------------
This model's rigging and chain design are done in Maya, and it's finished with the Mash plugin. Only the rigged model may be accessed in Maya due to the use of the Mash plugin. However, we designed this necklace so that it can be easily placed on any neck without need for many changes.
--------------------( (About the Meshes )) -------------------
Maya: includes one .mb file that assigned Vray materials and the necklace chain is rigged.
The second file is just rigged and no material is assigned to it.
FBX: Without materials (no mat and rig).
OBJ: one raw file (no mat and tx).
USD: one raw file (no mat and tx).
(in raw files you can assign in-pack textures in your 3dmesh yourself)
--------------------((About the textures )) -------------------
The textures made in 3 sizes for you, 4k,2k,1k(1024px)
*Important: we put a user guide folder in this package please read that before starting.
*This package includes only the ETHEREUM NECKLACE. Other objects shown in the picture are NOT included.

description_text: Angry Birds is an action-based media franchise created by the Finnish company Rovio Entertainment. The series focuses on multi-colored birds that try to save their eggs from green-colored pigs, their enemies. Inspired by Crush the Castle, the game has been praised for its successful combination of fun gameplay, comical style, and low price. Its popularity led to many spin-offs; versions of Angry Birds created for PCs and video game consoles, a market for merchandise featuring its characters, Angry Birds Toons, a televised animated series, and two films; The Angry Birds Movie and its sequel The Angry Birds Movie 2. By January 2014, there had been over 2 billion downloads across all platforms, including both regular and special editions.By July 2015, the series' games had been downloaded more than 3 billion times collectively, making it the most downloaded freemium game series of all time. The original Angry Birds has been called one of the most mainstream games out right now, one of the great runaway hits of 2010, and the largest mobile app success the world has seen so far. The first main-series video game sequel, Angry Birds 2, was released on 30 July 2015.The first game in the series was initially released in December 2009 for iOS. At the time, the swine flu epidemic was in the news, so the staff decided to use pigs as the enemies of the birds. The company released ports of the game to other touchscreen smartphone operating systems, including Android, Symbian, and Windows Phone, and PCs.

OVERVIEW
=======================
Simple and elegant high heels. Perfect for and female characters or decorate your architectural visualizations
You can see 3d preview of these shoes, take a look on my website if you wish:

=======================

  - Separated Pieces

  - FBX files

  - Collada(dae) files for OpenSim Version

  - Some Material Texture (for create materials)

description_text:
Especial troops created to cross the Fatum Fornax, portals to distances and dimensions never even imaginable to reach before.
Poseable and presupported troops which include:· Two heads (open and closed helmet)· Torso· 4 arm poses (both left and right)· 3 leg poses (with inverted versions)· Backpacks· 3 types of weapons.
If you have any thought about the model or any idea you want me to try for future models, feel free to send a message or leave a comment to let me know!
Printing parameters:
This models are intended for resin printers and tested with an Elegoo Mars and an Anycubic photon s.
The support are made for 0,03mm layers and the test prints you see in the image were made with this parameters as well as 6-9 seconds of exposure per layer depending on the resin.
I highly recommend to remove the supports after cleaning but before curing for better results. For the parts where the supports won't come out easy or are attached to delicate parts I also highly recommend to use clippers.

FILE FORMATS

description_text:
Walking stick 3D Model. Production-ready 3D Model, with PBR materials, textures, non overlapping UV Layout map provided in the package.
Quads only geometries (no tris/ngons).
Easily customizable: UV unwrapped geometries, so you can create new Textures (or modify the existing ones) using the UV Layout maps provided in the package (as png with alpha).
Each Object, Material or Texture provided in the package has a unique, meaningful name.
Made in Blender 3D 2.80 (Cycles / Eevee materials) then exported to OBJ and FBX; materials and textures made in Substance Painter, exported for PBR, V-Ray, Unity, Unreal.
PROMO IMAGES: the first image has been rendered in Cycles (or Eevee) for Blender 3D 2.8x; in particular, you can find 11+ promo images in this description:

  - nr. 1-2-3-4-5-6 rendered in Cycles (Blender 3D 2.80)

  - nr. 7-8 are wireframe images;

  - nr. 9-10 are screenshots from the Blender 3D scene, showing the UV Layout;

  - other images: UV layouts (at least one).

Formats included: FBX, OBJ; scenes: BLEND (2.80 with Cycles / Eevee materials); other: png with Alpha.
1 Object (mesh), 1 PBR Material, UV unwrapped (non overlapping UV Layout map provided in the package); UV-mapped Textures.
UV Layout maps and Image Textures resolutions: 2048x2048; PBR Textures made with Substance Painter.
Polygonal, QUADS ONLY (no tris/ngons); 6018 vertices, 5951 quad faces (11902 tris).
Real world dimensions; scene scale units: cm in Blender 3D (that is: Metric with 0.01 scale).
Uniform scale object (scale applied in Blender 3D).
PBR Multi-Engine Textures Pack included: in a zipped folder, you'll find the PBR Textures set for a bunch of rendering engines or game engines!

  - Cycles (or Eeevee) for Blender 3D (base color, occlusion + roughness + metallic + alpha (in a single PNG file), normal);

  - Vray for 3D Studio MAX (diffuse, reflect, reflection glossiness, normal);

  - Unity 5 Standard Metallic (albedo + transparency, metallic + smoothness, normal);

  - Unreal Engine 4 (base color + alpha, occlusion + roughness + metallic, normal);

  - generic PBR Spec Gloss workflow (diffuse + opacity, specular, glossiness, normal, height)

  - generic PBR Metal Rough workflow (base color + opacity, roughness, metallic, normal, height); you can use it in Eevee for Blender 3D 2.8, too;so, you'll be able to edit the Textures, or just import the fbx/obj file, along with the Textures set you want, in your 3D Modeling software or game engine, and link them together to get a game / production ready asset!

IMPORTANT --- Main renderings made in Blender 3D 2.80 + Cycles (or Eevee) using an HDR Environment Texture Image which is NOT provided in the package!

There was an odd issue with the object file, however. This model's .obj file had all negative f values, such as '-2389/-862/-4003 -2388/-861/-4002 -2391/-860/-4001 -2390/-859/-4000'. These values should all be 1 or higher. Fortunately I was able to fix this programmatically by adding the total number of position, texture, and normal values to that point to the appropriate coordinate in the f triplet. As for the model, it is very detailed with an almost metallic texture that lights very well. Animating it in a lit environment such as gives a nice 3D effect, particularly with the ribs. This modeler didn't take any short cuts. The object file's v, vt, vn, and f values are nicely separated by body parts which makes implementing effects like walking, swinging a sword, or bones coming apart a lot easier. It also includes separate .obj files for poses such as standing, sitting, or laying down which also came in handy for OpenGL. As there isn't armor or other accessories with this model, only one texture/color file was needed for each pose. With 41028 vertices, it draws fast for such high high detail. For an armored version of a skeleton I'd recommend 'Skeleton Footman Light Version', also from this modeler. I'd also recommend the '3 Smart Ancient Trees'. Death and Rat Death 3D model
My version of the popular character from Terry Pratchett's books, this is hopefully going to be used to make the sequel to his popular Discworld games series.
Death and rat death
Character Description

  - *.Blend (Blender) 

  - *.3Ds 

  - *.fbx 

  - *.mtl 

  - *.obj 

  - *.dxf 

  - All texture is included in the set.

The model is provided combined, all main parts are presented as separate parts therefore materials of objects are easy to be modified or removed and standard parts are easy to be replaced. If you experience difficulties with separating standard parts I am more than happy to give you qualified assistance. I greatly appreciate you choosing my 3D models and hope they will be of use. I look forward to continuously dealing with you. Enjoy it!

Sincerely Yours,
Luca

description_text:
Anatomy - Lumbar vertebra 3D Model. Production-ready 3D Model, with PBR materials, textures, non overlapping UV Layout map provided in the package.
Quads only geometries (no tris/ngons).
Easily customizable: UV unwrapped geometries, so you can create new Textures (or modify the existing ones) using the UV Layout maps provided in the package (as png with alpha).
Each Object, Material or Texture provided in the package has a unique, meaningful name.
Made in Blender 3D 2.80 (Cycles / Eevee materials) then exported to OBJ and FBX; materials and textures made in Substance Painter, exported for PBR, V-Ray, Unity, Unreal.
PROMO IMAGES: the first image has been rendered in Cycles (or Eevee) for Blender 3D 2.8x; in particular, you can find 11+ promo images in this description:

  - nr. 1-2-3-4-5-6 rendered in Cycles (Blender 3D 2.80)

  - nr. 7-8 are wireframe images;

  - nr. 9-10 are screenshots from the Blender 3D scene, showing the UV Layout;

  - other images: UV layouts (at least one).

Formats included: FBX, OBJ; scenes: BLEND (2.80 with Cycles / Eevee materials); other: png with Alpha.
1 Object (mesh), 1 PBR Material, UV unwrapped (non overlapping UV Layout map provided in the package); UV-mapped Textures.
UV Layout maps and Image Textures resolutions: 2048x2048; PBR Textures made with Substance Painter.
Polygonal, QUADS ONLY (no tris/ngons); 2688 vertices, 2688 quad faces (5376 tris).
Real world dimensions; scene scale units: cm in Blender 3D (that is: Metric with 0.01 scale).
Uniform scale object (scale applied in Blender 3D).
PBR Multi-Engine Textures Pack included: in a zipped folder, you'll find the PBR Textures set for a bunch of rendering engines or game engines!

  - Cycles (or Eeevee) for Blender 3D (base color, occlusion + roughness + metallic + alpha (in a single PNG file), normal);

  - Vray for 3D Studio MAX (diffuse, reflect, reflection glossiness, normal);

  - Unity 5 Standard Metallic (albedo + transparency, metallic + smoothness, normal);

  - Unreal Engine 4 (base color + alpha, occlusion + roughness + metallic, normal);

  - generic PBR Spec Gloss workflow (diffuse + opacity, specular, glossiness, normal, height)

  - generic PBR Metal Rough workflow (base color + opacity, roughness, metallic, normal, height); you can use it in Eevee for Blender 3D 2.8, too;so, you'll be able to edit the Textures, or just import the fbx/obj file, along with the Textures set you want, in your 3D Modeling software or game engine, and link them together to get a game / production ready asset!

IMPORTANT --- Main renderings made in Blender 3D 2.80 + Cycles (or Eevee) using an HDR Environment Texture Image which is NOT provided in the package!

description_text:
Sandals slippers shoes 3D Models, nr. 3 in my collection. 2 individual objects (left, right), sharing the same non overlapping UV Layout map, Material and PBR Textures set. Production-ready 3D Model, with PBR materials, textures, non overlapping UV Layout map provided in the package.
Quads only geometries (no tris/ngons).
Easily customizable: UV unwrapped geometries, so you can create new Textures (or modify the existing ones) using the UV Layout maps provided in the package (as png with alpha).
Each Object, Material or Texture provided in the package has a unique, meaningful name.
Made in Blender 3D 2.80 (Cycles / Eevee materials) then exported to OBJ and FBX; materials and textures made in Substance Painter, exported for PBR, V-Ray, Unity, Unreal.
PROMO IMAGES: the first image has been rendered in Cycles (or Eevee) for Blender 3D 2.8x; in particular, you can find 11+ promo images in this description:

  - nr. 1-2-3-4-5-6 rendered in Cycles (Blender 3D 2.80)

  - nr. 7-8 are wireframe images;

  - nr. 9-10 are screenshots from the Blender 3D scene, showing the UV Layout;

  - other images: UV layouts (at least one).

Formats included: FBX, OBJ; scenes: BLEND (2.80 with Cycles / Eevee materials); other: png with Alpha.
2 Objects (meshes), 1 PBR Material, UV unwrapped (non overlapping UV Layout map provided in the package); UV-mapped Textures.
UV Layout maps and Image Textures resolutions: 2048x2048; PBR Textures made with Substance Painter.
Polygonal, QUADS ONLY (no tris/ngons); 16296 vertices, 15696 quad faces (31392 tris).
Real world dimensions; scene scale units: cm in Blender 3D (that is: Metric with 0.01 scale).
Uniform scale object (scale applied in Blender 3D).
PBR Multi-Engine Textures Pack included: in a zipped folder, you'll find the PBR Textures set for a bunch of rendering engines or game engines!

  - Cycles (or Eeevee) for Blender 3D (base color, occlusion + roughness + metallic + alpha (in a single PNG file), normal);

  - Vray for 3D Studio MAX (diffuse, reflect, reflection glossiness, normal);

  - Unity 5 Standard Metallic (albedo + transparency, metallic + smoothness, normal);

  - Unreal Engine 4 (base color + alpha, occlusion + roughness + metallic, normal);

  - generic PBR Spec Gloss workflow (diffuse + opacity, specular, glossiness, normal, height)

  - generic PBR Metal Rough workflow (base color + opacity, roughness, metallic, normal, height); you can use it in Eevee for Blender 3D 2.8, too;so, you'll be able to edit the Textures, or just import the fbx/obj file, along with the Textures set you want, in your 3D Modeling software or game engine, and link them together to get a game / production ready asset!

IMPORTANT --- Main renderings made in Blender 3D 2.80 + Cycles (or Eevee) using an HDR Environment Texture Image which is NOT provided in the package!
